features: THE DOUBLE-ENTRY CHECK NOW LOOKS AT THE DOCUMENT TOO — It verified that the books were consistent with themselves, not that they were right against the invoice: a document recorded as € 100.14 instead of the € 100.15 the supplier asks for balances perfectly, because both sides of the entry are wrong by the same amount. Now, for every invoice imported from XML, it compares the recorded total with the one the supplier declared in the file and writes it as an equation with the real figures — «declared € 100.15 = recorded € 100.15, matches» — instead of a single «all ok» indicator. The comparison is only possible on invoices imported from the previous version onwards, the only ones that keep the declared totals: on an older archive the answer says so, instead of suggesting everything is fine.

THE CHECK'S STATUS NOW TELLS THREE CASES APART, NOT TWO — Consistent books; consistent books but with a document recorded for an amount different from the one the supplier declares; a real accounting anomaly. The middle case is not an error: the program warns and does not block when an entry is not worth what the document asks, so a different amount may have been chosen deliberately.

THE CHECK NOW HAS TESTS, WHERE IT HAD NONE — Had it stopped noticing anomalies it would have answered «all in order» and nobody would have known. Seven tests now put purpose-built anomalies in front of it and require it to find them.

«OUTSIDE BUDGET» IS NO LONGER OFFERED ON A CREDIT NOTE — That button declares an unforeseen expense that exceeds the budget, and a credit note frees the budget. Pressing it marked the document as a justified overrun, and from that moment it could be neither edited nor reversed: it stayed stuck with no way out.

CHANGING THE DOCUMENT TYPE CLEARS THE OVERRUN JUSTIFICATION — It was enough to write it on an invoice, change your mind and switch the document to a credit note: the justification stayed attached to a document that could not have produced it, with the same lock-up as a result. The flag and its justification now belong to the document that generated them.

CREDIT NOTES FROM REVERSALS ALREADY IN THE ARCHIVE CAN NO LONGER BE OFFSET — The earlier correction only covered new notes: those generated before remained selectable in payments, and a supplier could have an amount deducted using a document they never issued. They are now recognised by their link to the invoice they cancelled, with no need to alter any data.

THE MENU NO LONGER OFFERS TO PAY A NOTE THAT CANNOT BE PAID — The document no longer appeared among the payable ones, but «Record payment» stayed in the menu: the form opened without finding the note, and without explaining why.
THE EURO SYMBOL BEFORE THE AMOUNT — In the accounting check's response it appeared after the figure in nine places.
